# data/external — large published inputs (NOT in git)

These files are **published, large (~358 MB), and gitignored**. They belong in this
directory (or wherever `$DARKPROTEOME_DATA` points); `src/darkproteome/paths.py`
resolves them.

**This README is the only file in this directory tracked by git** — so the
recovery instructions survive even though the data does not.

## What must be here

| path | what | size | re-download |
|---|---|---|---|

The manifest used for the re-analysis points here, not at `pxd055609_raw/`. | ~3.1 GB | Regenerate from `pxd055609_raw/` (above): `docker run --rm --platform linux/amd64 -v <rawdir>:/raw:ro -v <outdir>:/out quay.io/biocontainers/thermorawfileparser:2.0.0.dev--h9ee0642_1 ThermoRawFileParser -i /raw/<file>.raw -o /out -f 1 -L 2` per file |

Re-collect via the general search UI at `https://systemhc.sjtu.edu.cn/explore?protein_id=uc&search_hit=&top_allele=<ALLELE>&PTM=&mhc_class=` (never `systemhcatlas.org` — untrusted, see `../SOURCES.md`) — full re-collection procedure, query list, and the classification regex are in `systemhc_check.py`'s own docstring |
| `systemhc/nonuniprot_melanoma_resample_{A01,A01_repeat,A26,A29,A30,A31,A32,B44,B35,C04}.tsv` | Targeted follow-up to the row above — 10 more raw, untouched `/explore` search-result dumps (same `protein_id=uc` filter, 8 pre-registered new common-HLA alleles beyond the original 8 + a repeat of A01) collected via plain `curl` rather than a rendered browser tab (discovered this session: the page is server-rendered HTML, and curl reads the FULL "first 1000 hits" response instead of a browser's rendered-viewport slice — ~10x the rows per query) — input to a follow-up analysis (not shipped in this release), which grew the SYSMHC00057 melanoma sample from n=131 to n=1,951 and also surfaced a third dataset (SYSMHC00064, glioblastoma, PMID 35675780) in the same bucket, written up in `systemhc_third_dataset_and_methods.md` | 880 KB | Same re-collection procedure as the row above, `top_allele` ∈ {A26,A29,A30,A31,A32,B44,B35,C04} (curl, not a browser) — full query list and the non-determinism check are in `systemhc_melanoma_targeted_resample.py`'s own docstring |

Full provenance, licenses, and table-level notes: **`../SOURCES.md`**.

## If this directory is empty/lost
1. Re-download each file above into this exact relative layout, **or**
2. set `DARKPROTEOME_DATA` to wherever they live.

Self-check after restoring: `python3 src/darkproteome/tier1_nonnovelty.py` must
print `5/2979`, `43/116 = 37.1%`, `0 mismatches`, `54.4%`.
